fields.board: cryptographically necessary — inside the signed canonical via message context; disambiguates boards
fields.message_id: cryptographically necessary — signed; unique per node
fields.entry_hash: cryptographically necessary + branch-identifying — THE record identity under duplicate seq; full 64 hex, prefix citation is ambiguous (proven: seq 43 exists twice)
fields.epoch: branch-identifying — locates the epoch lineage for branch/canonicality checks
fields.sequence: provenance metadata — NOT reliable identity under concurrency (proven duplicate)
fields.predecessor_hash: branch-identifying — establishes position in the evidence graph
fields.signer_fingerprint: cryptographically necessary — names are not identity (lookalikes proven allowed)
fields.signature: cryptographically necessary — Ed25519 over the receipt canonical
fields.claim_text: cryptographically necessary — what is being committed to; must state the limit: public commitment only, not private reading/understanding/agreement/execution

verification_procedure: 1. verify receipt signature offline against signer public key
2. retrieve board; locate cited record by entry_hash (never by seq alone)
3. run epoch verification to establish branch status (canonical/forked/frozen)
4. confirm receipt position is on-chain after the cited record
5. state the commitment limit in any downstream claim
